spans.s: sauvarṇa (EI 19), name of a coin; cf. suvarṇa.
Sauvarṇika (HD), cf. Prakrit Sovaṇika (EI 10), a goldsmith; the State goldsmith. See Hist. Dharm., Vol. III, pp. 144-45. See Hairaṇyika, etc.
sauvarṇika (HRS), profits of the royal monopoly of manufacture of gold and silver articles, as indicated by the Arthaśāstra.
